recommendations.action: Replace row claiming with portfolio claiming
recommendations.rule: Every worker claims one immutable portfolio manifest. Queue rows remain evidence and closure dependents, not separate prompts.
recommendations.impact: 121 rows become 35 primary context scopes (3.46x compression).

recommendations.rule: A single complete-course read produces lesson, visual, language, progression, choice, math, illustration and standards-evidence contracts; writers receive delta-only subpackets.
recommendations.impact: 0 pending course reads can settle 0 generic disposition rows before implementation.

recommendations.action: Split standards into cached source contracts and evidence joins
recommendations.rule: Fetch and sign each exact official code once, reuse the course evidence card, and write an edge-level verdict for every mapping. Never infer approval from family resemblance.
recommendations.impact: 2 open edges are organized into 1 parent families, 2 required exact-code subgroups, and 2 bounded review batches.

recommendations.action: Repair shared renderer and generator causes before prose rows
recommendations.rule: Prioritize 0 live math boundary contracts and 0 generator-domain portfolios; reopen all consumers from dependency hashes.
recommendations.impact: 0 rows share bounded runtime/generator causes; all 0 exact generator tags remain mandatory subgroups.

recommendations.action: Replace static illustration one-offs with typed semantic figure families
recommendations.rule: Canary a figureSpec contract that derives visual, accessible description and explanation from one semantic state; batch by figure+course and cap at 20 placements.
recommendations.impact: 0 rows compile into 0 semantic contracts / 0 safe write batches.

recommendations.action: Run risk-tiered QA with reviewer backpressure
recommendations.rule: Full deterministic gates on every packet; full semantic review for P0/novel math; representative+unseen-seed review for repeated, contract-identical rows. Stop writers when more than two packets wait per assessor.
recommendations.impact: Preserves independent acceptance while eliminating repeated narrative handoffs and wait-for-all barriers.

defaultEightAgentWorkMode.composition: 1 root/architect, 2 independent assessors, 3 file-disjoint implementers, 1 evidence/cache worker, 1 integration steward
defaultEightAgentWorkMode.cohort: 3–5 tasks with one dependency level; never wait for one slow standards/browser task behind short scans.
defaultEightAgentWorkMode.readyForReviewCap: At most two completed packets waiting per assessor.

operatingModel.fourAgentFallback: 1 root, 1 assessor, 1 implementer, 1 evidence/integration worker; three-course assessment cohorts become one-course cohorts but use identical packet manifests.

modelRouting.architectureAndAdjudication: GPT-5.6 Sol, High; Extra High/Max only for conflicts; Standard speed
modelRouting.standardsAndMathVerdict: GPT-5.6 Sol, High/Extra High; Fast only when one verdict unlocks at least three blocked workers

operatingModel.cacheContract: Stable charter/rubric/schema prefix first; packet data last. Key deterministic artifacts by source hash + tool version; semantic judgments additionally by contract/rubric/model/effort. Handoffs are delta-only and under 600 words plus artifact references.

assumptions: Portfolio compression reduces repeated context loading; it does not auto-close any semantic queue row.
The disposition scenario uses all 1701 current signed reviews and may overstate or understate the revision rate in unreviewed courses.
Standards verdicts remain edge-level and require exact official source/full-intent review even when source text is cached by code.
Typed semantic figures must pass a representative canary before the 0 live count-on-hops placements can scale.
